bullets: On small screens, the action prompts are slim pills that stay out of the way, and the Lamplighter's speech bubble is smaller
Messages stay on screen longer, the longest ones longest, and so do the Lamplighter's words
The Crier's Board page-turn prompt now sits below the board, so it no longer covers the notices
Your sword rests low at your side, and your left hand holds the raised shield
Sword combos now cut an X
The Fireball Glove hand rests at your side until you start charging
The Lamplighter now looks just as he does in the VR game

releases.title: The Lamplighter
bullets: Meet the Lamplighter at his desk in Lanternhall. He speaks in speech bubbles
The Crier's Board pages through all of the hall's current news, not just the newest notice

releases.title: Badges
bullets: Five free badges to earn: Triumph!, Ironheart!, None fell!, Kingbreaker! and Hammer down!
Credits are in the Comfort tab

releases.title: Fair Play
bullets: Party stones no longer wait forever: once most of the party is on, a short countdown brings everyone along
Step away from the game and you're marked Away, so the rest of the party can carry on
The fellowship can vote to head home together, or to part ways with a bearer who's spoiling the fun
Keys, seals and bell-weights can't be hoarded: held too long, they slip back where they belong
